note: Larkspur’s planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not measurements of any real shop or release. Every count the Releases module shows comes from these and from the changes in changes.json.

words.traffic: 100 checkouts a minute, about 1 in 100 failing on any day (a card refused, a timeout)
words.rollback: putting the old version back on every server takes 5 minutes
words.flag: switching a flag off reaches every server within 1 minute
words.threshold: the check rings when the canary’s failures beat everyone else’s by more than 2 in 100
